description: ADCOS Path object: an ordered set of links that can satisfy a session or resource intent. Required properties encode the frozen carries-list of spec/architecture.md §6.6. Path computation and scoring semantics are owned by WORK-011; the metrics/policy_score/confidence structures are deliberately open.

confidence.description: Confidence and provenance of the path assessment; evidence semantics owned by later Work Items.

expiry.description: Path expiry; temporal encoding owned by WORK-003.

failover_options.description: Alternate/failover path references retained for graceful degradation (LOCK-013).

metrics.description: Measured path metrics; measurement model owned by WORK-026.

policy_score.description: Opaque policy scoring data; semantics owned by the routing Work Item (WORK-011).

title: ADCOS Path
